title: Supporting nonprofit and community innovation
summary: OpenAI launches a $50M People-First AI Fund to help U.S. nonprofits scale impact with AI. Applications open Sept 8–Oct 8, 2025 for grants in education, healthcare, research, and more.
body: OpenAI launches a $50M People-First AI Fund to help U.S. nonprofits scale impact with AI. Applications open Sept 8–Oct 8, 2025 for grants in education, healthcare, research, and more.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布推出5000万美元的People-First AI Fund基金，旨在帮助美国非营利组织在教育、医疗和研究等领域利用人工智能扩大影响力。
